evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/services/voice_commands.rs:267 action_report_fault is a placeholder: it generates a throwaway fault_id = Uuid::new_v4() (:279), returns VoiceActionResult { success: true, ... } and tells the resident 'Porucha bola nahlasena. Cislo tiketu je {first-8-of-uuid}' (:282) — but it NEVER calls a fault repository. The inline comment at :278 says 'In a real implementation, this would create a fault via the fault repository'. Nothing is persisted.

This path is reachable in production: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/voice_webhooks.rs:162/:265 call VoiceCommandService::process_command -> execute_action (voice_commands.rs:161 -> :185) -> action_report_fault for voice_intent::REPORT_FAULT (dispatch at voice_commands.rs:144). A resident who reports a fault by voice (Alexa/Google webhook) is told it was filed and given a ticket number, but no fault record exists — silent data loss on a user-facing safety/maintenance flow.

Fix: create the fault via the real fault repository inside a tenant/RLS scope and return the persisted id, or fail closed (error response) until the handler is implemented rather than fabricating a success + ticket number.

backend/servers/api-server/src/services/voice_commands.rs:235 action_check_balance returns a hardcoded response ('Your current balance is zero. You have no outstanding fees.') with data { balance: 0.0, currency: EUR } and success:true, regardless of the resident's actual financial state. Comment at :240-241 confirms it is a placeholder ('this would query the financial repository. For now, return a placeholder response').

Same class of fabricated-data placeholders in the same dispatch table: action at :321 (check_announcements — 'this would query the announcement repository') and :373 (check_meter — 'this would query the meter repository'). All are reachable via the voice webhook path (routes/voice_webhooks.rs process_command -> execute_action dispatch, voice_commands.rs:143-151).

Reporting a false zero balance / no-fees to residents over a voice assistant is misleading financial information on a live endpoint. Fix: wire the handlers to their real repositories, or return an 'unavailable' response instead of fabricated values while unimplemented.

backend/servers/api-server/src/services/notification.rs:364 — for the InApp channel, add_notification_to_group is called with entity_id.unwrap_or(Uuid::new_v4()) as the grouping/entity key. When a notification has no associated entity (entity_id == None), a fresh random UUID is minted as the group key, so every entity-less in-app notification lands in its own unique group and can never be coalesced or re-associated.

The dedup key recorded at :386 (record_sent(user_id, notification_type, entity_id)) uses the original Option entity_id, so the grouping key (random) and the dedup key (None) diverge for the same notification. Fix: use a stable sentinel (e.g. Uuid::nil()) or a type/user-derived key instead of Uuid::new_v4() so entity-less notifications group deterministically.
